# Airsup dependencies

`des.js` and `three.bundle.js` are copied unchanged from [AirsupHQ/factory-skill](https://github.com/AirsupHQ/factory-skill), commit `9fde7554e6a30e77ea1008dec08f2ba8d8d37f27`, inspected October 19, 2026. MIT licenses are included beside these files. The Three.js bundle is r185 with addons.

Megawatt's deployment specification, scene, interface and tests are original adaptations. This is not the source of Airsup's warehouse-ops page and does not reproduce that page's artwork. No affiliation with Airsup or Base Power is implied.
